titulo: A King Tried to Ban Coffee ☕
frases: In 1675, a king tried to ban coffee.
King Charles the Second ordered every coffee house in England to close.
Why? People sat there for hours, sharing news and gossip about the government.
The ban would start on January 10th.
Two days before the deadline, the king backed down.
So, would you give up coffee for a king?

nota_datos: Carlos II de Inglaterra: proclama del 29-dic-1675 para cerrar los coffee houses desde el 10-ene-1676; molestia general; el 8-ene-1676 dio marcha atrás (proclama adicional que posterga y nunca se aplicó).
